in_sanskrit.name: धनजय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: He who has victory over wealth. He who has victory through wealth.

in_telugu.name: దన్జేయ

in_marathi.name: Dhanjay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of Dhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhanjay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Dhan' meaning wealth and 'Jay' meaning victory. This name is given to a boy symbolizing the victory of wealth or prosperity.
